summary: This is a purely additive, reference-only archive task (two new generator/register scripts plus one new YAML catalog file, no .github/workflows/** or migration/auth/schema/permission/billing paths touched) and independently verified rather than trusted from the self-report: the source instruction INS-20260724-060111-0975 was pulled live from superboss-register.sqlite and its raw_text matches the 34 repos, 3 NONE entries, and 4 high_relevance flags transcribed into the catalog almost exactly; re-running generate_xpost_github_catalog.py produced byte-identical output to the committed YAML, confirming it is a real mechanical transcription and not hand-authored/hallucinated; and the knowledge_engine row KE-20260724-062517-e6b1 was confirmed live in the sqlite DB with a real sha256 content_hash, VERIFIED_MATCH status, correct tags (including claudexor and code-review-graph), and entity_relationships resolving against two real files on disk (anthropic_openrouter_proxy_v2.py, superboss-register.py). The register script uses only list-form subprocess calls (no shell injection risk), is idempotent via a pre-check query, and follows this repo's existing VERIDIAN_ROOT/register-knowledge conventions. The worker was also transparent about a real discrepancy (task spec said 32 real repos, ground truth was 34) rather than silently reconciling it.
issues: Minor: the source instruction's raw_text also appends '-- relevant to Document Engine' to iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI, a 5th inline relevance annotation, but the catalog only flags high_relevance for the 4 repos the instruction's closing sentence explicitly enumerates, leaving OfficeCLI as false; defensible per the instruction's own summary line but worth a human glance.
Minor: generate_xpost_github_catalog.py defines VERIDIAN_ROOT but never uses it (dead code).

Minor/systemic (not unique to this task): the knowledge_engine row's primary artifact_path points at the task's own ephemeral workspace directory rather than a path that survives after the worktree is cleaned up; the merged-repo location is only recorded as an unverified secondary_path, so a future verify-knowledge pass could mark this row PATH_MISSING even though the merged file still exists at the secondary path.
